text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A while after the championship tournament, 
Ryoka Tsurugi and the others delivered the 
news that a 2nd U.A.F. had been officially 
decided.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They expressed their commitment to 
continue putting in efforts so that this 
competition would become entertainment on 
par with the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Becoming more and more the talk of the 
town— the 'U.A.F.'—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Surely, this will continue to bring forth 
the sparkling brilliance of many athlete 
Umamusume.
